endorsements.name: Seunghyun Lee
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-8385
endorsements.description: A difference in the handling of StructFields and ArrayTypes in WASM could be used to trigger an exploitable type confusion vulnerability. This vulnerability affects Firefox < 130, Firefox ESR < 128.2, and Thunderbird < 128.2.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Seunghyun Lee
endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Vancouver 2024 - Day One Results
endorsements.description: Seunghyun Lee ( @0x10n ) of KAIST Hacking Lab was able to execute their exploit of the Google Chrome web browser using a single UAF bug. They earn $60,000 and 6 Master of Pwn points.
endorsements.subtitle: Pwn2Own 2024

povs.explanation: Pwn2Own validates successful exploitation through live competition and independent expert verification.

endorsements.name: Seunghyun Lee
endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Vancouver 2024 - Day Two Results
endorsements.description: Seunghyun Lee ( @0x10n ) of KAIST Hacking Lab used a UAF to RCE in the renderer on both Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome. He earns $85,000 and 9 Master of Pwn points. That brings his contest total to $145,000 and 15 Master of Pwn points.
endorsements.subtitle: Pwn2Own 2024

povs.explanation: Pwn2Own validates successful exploitation through live competition and independent expert verification.
